Naoko Morisawa’s “My Dahlia” Wins Award at Akashi City Art Exhibition

By
Hikari Kono
-
November 10, 2026
Facebook
X
Pinterest
WhatsApp
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:45
    Instaread

    “My Dahlia,” a work by mosaic artist Naoko Morisawa, whose art appears regularly in the North American Post, received a Merit Award in the Western-style painting category of the 73rd Akashi City Art Exhibition in Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. The piece will be on display at the Akashi Municipal Cultural Museum from Nov. 18 through Nov. 22, offering a chance to see its vivid layers of red and yellow up close.

    Exhibition details
    Dates: Wednesday, Nov. 18 – Sunday, Nov. 22
    Hours: 10 a.m. – 5 p.m. ＊until 3 p.m. on Nov. 22
    Location: Akashi Municipal Cultural Museum, 2nd Floor Gallery
    2-chome-13-1 Uenomaru, Akashi, Hyogo 673-0846
    More info: www.accf.or.jp/news/bijututen (Japanese)
